Foxy keeps Arma 3 repositories, addon se: Foxy keeps Arma 3 repositories, addon selection, launch settings, downloads, and recovery tools in one desktop app.
If you are new, read this page first and: If you are new, read this page first and then continue to Getting started for the exact first steps.
Start in the repository list. That is th: Start in the repository list. That is the main screen where each repository card shows sync state, favorite status, launch actions, and server information.
Use the bottom-left controls for referen: Use the bottom-left controls for reference material. The info icon opens About, the question mark opens this Help page, and the version number opens the changelog.
Open a repository or its settings when y: Open a repository or its settings when you want to change addon selections, profiles, startup parameters, or maintenance actions for that repository.
Use Settings for global app behavior suc: Use Settings for global app behavior such as paths, language, backup rules, direct download, UI customization, renderer preference (Auto, WGPU, Glow), and activity log visibility.
This is the simplest first-time setup pa: This is the simplest first-time setup path if you only want to get a repository installed and ready to launch.
Click + Add repository on the main repos: Click + Add repository on the main repository screen.
Paste either a repository URL or a repos: Paste either a repository URL or a repository space URL. If the source is a repository space, Foxy can help you pick one or more repositories from it.
Choose the local folder where the reposi: Choose the local folder where the repository should live. This is where Foxy will check files, download updates, and launch from.
After the repository appears in the list: After the repository appears in the list, run Refresh to fetch remote metadata and build the first update plan.
When Foxy reports that updates are avail: When Foxy reports that updates are available, open the update screen, review the summary, and start the download. If Foxy detects a risky near-full redownload caused by path/root mismatch, it pauses and explains what to fix before continuing. After that, use Launch or Join with the profile you want.
Foxy uses different checks for different: Foxy uses different checks for different jobs. The short version is: Refresh quickly compares the remote repository hash with the local one, Quick local check inspects your local files, and Recheck repository integrity performs a full remote fetch with complete hash recalculation.
Use Refresh when you want the newest rem: Use Refresh when you want the newest remote metadata, update plan, server-side addon metadata/preflight data, and file information for a repository.
Use Quick local check when you suspect l: Use Quick local check when you suspect local changes, manual edits, or missing files. It compares local content hashes and is much faster than a full hash rebuild.
When an update is ready, open the update: When an update is ready, open the update view and review which mods changed, how many files or parts will be downloaded, and the total size before starting.
During download, Foxy prefers delta patc: During download, Foxy prefers delta patches when possible. If a patch cannot be validated or applied safely, it automatically falls back to downloading the full file.
Profiles are presets for how Arma 3 shou: Profiles are presets for how Arma 3 should start with a specific repository. They save time when you switch between different servers, unit setups, or optional addon combinations.
Open Repository Settings and select or c: Open Repository Settings and select or create a profile for that repository.
Configure the profile by enabling or dis: Configure the profile by enabling or disabling addons, optional addons, external addons, DLC toggles, and extra launch parameters (including explicit -profiles=<path> when needed).
Use Copy Profile when you want to start: Use Copy Profile when you want to start from an existing preset instead of building a new one from zero.
Back on the repository card, make sure t: Back on the repository card, make sure the profile you want is selected, then click Launch to start Arma 3 with that configuration.
Use Join when the repository has a confi: Use Join when the repository has a configured server and you want Foxy to launch the game and connect to that server immediately after startup.
Repository spaces are useful when a comm: Repository spaces are useful when a community publishes several related repositories under one shared manifest. They help with required repositories, optional repositories, and shared paths.
Add a repository space the same way you: Add a repository space the same way you add a normal repository: paste the space URL into the add dialog.
If the space contains multiple repositor: If the space contains multiple repositories, Foxy lets you choose which ones to add and where they should be stored.
Use a shared path when the repositories: Use a shared path when the repositories in that space should live under one common root folder.
External addons are addons that are avai: External addons are addons that are available outside the repository itself. Foxy can discover them from repository-space shared paths, additional search folders from Settings, and Steam Workshop content when enabled.

External addons are addons that are available outside the repository itself. Foxy can discover them from repository-space shared paths, additional search folders from Game space settings, and Steam Workshop content when enabled.
When you edit addon selections for a rep: When you edit addon selections for a repository, pay attention to whether an addon comes from the repository, from optional content, or from an external source. You can also mark addons as favorites and filter by favorite state.
Foxy includes recovery tools for safer u: Foxy includes recovery tools for safer updates and a direct download tool for situations where you want files without full repository sync.
Enable automatic addon backups before up: Enable automatic addon backups before updates if you want restore points before Foxy changes local content.
Use the Backup Manager in Settings to re: Use the Backup Manager in Settings to review stored backups, cleanup rules, and overall backup storage usage.
If you need to roll back one addon, open: If you need to roll back one addon, open Repository Settings and restore the specific addon backup from there so Foxy knows the target path.
Use Direct download when you want to dow: Use Direct download when you want to download a repository, addon, or single file from a URL without importing it into Foxy's repository database flow.
If something looks wrong after an interr: If something looks wrong after an interrupted or unusual update, start with Quick local check, then Refresh, and only use deeper maintenance actions if the normal checks do not resolve it.
Settings control how Foxy behaves global: Settings control how Foxy behaves globally. The activity log and footer controls help you understand what the app is doing and where to look next.
Use the Application settings tab to conf: Use the Application settings tab to configure language, game paths, temporary storage, startup behavior, renderer preference, and other global options.
Use the Application settings tab to configure language, Steam path, temporary storage, startup behavior, renderer preference, and other global options.
Use the Customization tab if you want to: Use the Customization tab if you want to change UI font sizes or palette colors without touching repository data.
Open the activity log from the bottom-ri: Open the activity log from the bottom-right footer button when you want to see current work, recent backend events, or troubleshooting details.
Use About for app information, Help for: Use About for app information, Help for usage guidance, and the changelog for version-by-version feature and fix history.
If you are unsure what to do next, check: If you are unsure what to do next, check the repository state banner first, then the activity log, then the relevant Help category for the screen you are using.
Add repositories with + Add repository,: Add repositories with + Add repository, then enter a repository URL or repository space URL and choose where the files should be stored.
Open a repository to review its addons,: Open a repository to review its addons, favorites, server entries, launch profiles, Editor Missions tools, and maintenance actions.
Use Refresh when you want the latest rem: Use Refresh when you want the latest remote metadata, update plan, and server-provided addon metadata for a repository.
Use Quick local check to compare your lo: Use Quick local check to compare your local content hashes and detect drift without rebuilding every stored hash.

It checks local files for integrity issues or changes.
Use Recheck repository integrity when yo: Use Recheck repository integrity when you need a full remote fetch and complete hash recalculation after major local changes or suspected corruption.
When an update is ready, open the update: When an update is ready, open the update view to review changed mods, file counts, and total size before downloading.
Foxy prefers delta patches when availabl: Foxy prefers delta patches when available and automatically falls back to full file downloads if patch validation fails.
Profiles store launch parameters, DLC to: Profiles store launch parameters, DLC toggles, addon enablement, optional extras, and custom arguments such as -profiles=<path> so you can switch between presets quickly.
Use Launch to start Arma 3 with the sele: Use Launch to start Arma 3 with the selected profile. Use Join when a repository has a configured server and you want to connect after launch.
Repository spaces group multiple reposit: Repository spaces group multiple repositories under one manifest and can share a common local path for unit-wide setups.
External addons can come from shared rep: External addons can come from shared repository-space paths, additional folders from Settings, or detected Steam Workshop content when enabled.
The Direct download page downloads repos: The Direct download page downloads repositories, addons, or individual files from a URL without syncing them into the database.
In Direct download, destination defaults: In Direct download, destination defaults to Temporary Directory and then to the Foxy config directory if Temporary Directory is empty.
Enable addon backups before updates if y: Enable addon backups before updates if you want recovery points. You can manage stored backups centrally and restore a specific addon from repository settings.
Settings lets you change app paths, lang: Settings lets you change app paths, language, fonts, colors, backup rules, startup behavior, renderer preference, and app update behavior.
Use Auto recheck repositories on launch: Use Auto recheck repositories on launch and Auto quick scan for changes on launch in Application settings to start background verification automatically. Startup tasks run after first render so the UI remains responsive.

The activity log in the bottom right sho: The activity log in the bottom right shows what the app is doing now and keeps recent backend messages available for troubleshooting.
The info icon opens About, the question: The info icon opens About, the question mark opens this Help page, and the version number opens the changelog.

Server cards show each server's name, ad: Server cards show each server's name, address, online status, and player count. Use Arrow Left and Arrow Right to navigate between them.
If Steam is not running, Foxy starts it: If Steam is not running, Foxy starts it automatically before launching Arma 3. Configure post-launch behavior in Settings to close or hide to tray.
Use the space toolbar to Recheck all, Qu: Use the space toolbar to Recheck all, Quick local check all, or Update all repositories in the space at once. For CLI automation, space sync also supports select/exclude targeting.
If you added repositories individually b: If you added repositories individually before creating the space, use Scan existing repositories to find and move matches into the space.
Use Force redownload repository in Repos: Use Force redownload repository in Repository Settings to remove local files and re-download everything when normal checks cannot resolve a problem. Foxy now guards against accidental near-full redownloads caused by path/root mismatches and explains how to fix them.

Most buttons and clickable surfaces show: Most buttons and clickable surfaces show a pointer cursor on hover to indicate that they are interactive.
If something is not working as expected,: If something is not working as expected, these steps cover the most common issues and how to resolve them.
If a repository shows an unexpected stat: If a repository shows an unexpected state, run Quick local check first, then Refresh. This resolves most drift and stale-metadata issues.
If downloads fail repeatedly, check your: If downloads fail repeatedly, check your internet connection, verify the repository URL is reachable in a browser, and review the activity log for specific error messages. Foxy now applies adaptive resource limits during hashing and downloads when memory pressure is constrained or severe.
If the app reports hash mismatches after: If the app reports hash mismatches after an update, use Recheck repository integrity to fetch fresh remote data and rebuild stored checksums from scratch.
If a repository is stuck in an updating: If a repository is stuck in an updating state, check the activity log for errors. You can use Wipe database for that repository and re-add it as a last resort. Equivalent local path variants (trailing slash, case, canonical form) are normalized automatically to reduce false reset/redownload triggers.
If external addons are not detected, ver: If external addons are not detected, verify that the search folders are configured in Settings and that Steam Workshop scanning is enabled if you use Workshop content.
If external addons are not detected, verify that the search folders are configured in Game space settings and that Steam Workshop scanning is enabled if you use Workshop content.
If launch fails or the wrong addons load: If launch fails or the wrong addons load, verify the selected profile in Repository Settings and check that addon paths, UTF-8 profile/mission names, and DLC toggles are correct.
If startup logs mention Vulkan layers su: If startup logs mention Vulkan layers such as VK_LAYER_bandicam_helper, update or disable Bandicam and other screen-capture overlays, then restart Foxy. If WGPU crashes are detected, Foxy stores a recovery marker and can auto-switch to Glow on next launch, then shows a notice so you can review renderer settings.
Check the activity log in the bottom-rig: Check the activity log in the bottom-right corner for detailed backend messages. You can copy the full log to clipboard for sharing with support.
Log files are stored in the Foxy config: Log files are stored in the Foxy config directory under the logs folder. On Windows this is typically %APPDATA%\Foxy\logs. Foxy cleans up logs older than 90 days and keeps up to 16 recent log files.

Third-party overlays such as NVIDIA GeFo: Third-party overlays such as NVIDIA GeForce Experience, NVIDIA App, Discord, Steam, Bandicam, and similar screen-capture or recording tools can attach to Foxy on startup and cause unwanted pop-ups, performance issues, or rendering glitches.
Foxy is a desktop application, not a gam: Foxy is a desktop application, not a game, so it does not benefit from in-game overlays. You can safely exclude Foxy from these overlays without losing any functionality.
NVIDIA GeForce Experience or NVIDIA App:: NVIDIA GeForce Experience or NVIDIA App: open the app, go to Settings, find the in-game overlay or Games and Apps section, and add Foxy to the excluded applications list.
If you do not use NVIDIA features like i: If you do not use NVIDIA features like instant replay, screenshots, or recording, you can disable the NVIDIA in-game overlay globally in NVIDIA App settings.
NVIDIA classifies any DirectX 12 or Vulk: NVIDIA classifies any DirectX 12 or Vulkan application as a potential game. This behavior is not specific to Foxy and there is no supported way for Foxy to opt out programmatically.
Discord overlay: open Discord, go to Use: Discord overlay: open Discord, go to User Settings, Game Activity, then either remove Foxy from the detected games list or disable the overlay for it.
Steam overlay: if Foxy was launched thro: Steam overlay: if Foxy was launched through Steam, open Steam, go to Settings, In-Game, and disable the Steam overlay for Foxy via its properties. Foxy is normally not launched through Steam, so this usually does not apply.
Screen-capture tools such as Bandicam, O: Screen-capture tools such as Bandicam, OBS, ShadowPlay, and Xbox Game Bar: exclude Foxy from their auto-capture lists. On Windows you can also disable Xbox Game Bar capture for Foxy under Windows Settings, Gaming, Captures.
After changing overlay settings, fully c: After changing overlay settings, fully close and relaunch Foxy so the overlay hooks do not re-attach to the running process.
If the NVIDIA GeForce Experience or NVID: If the NVIDIA GeForce Experience or NVIDIA App overlay pops up every time Foxy launches, add Foxy to the excluded applications list in NVIDIA App settings. See the Third-party overlays help tab for details.
For other overlays such as Discord, Stea: For other overlays such as Discord, Steam, Bandicam, OBS, or Xbox Game Bar, see the Third-party overlays help tab for per-tool exclusion steps.

Foxy includes broad localization support: Foxy includes broad localization support with locale-aware pluralization, formatting, and dedicated font coverage for Arabic, Persian, Urdu, and Hebrew.
If a legacy setup contains multiple entr: If a legacy setup contains multiple entries from the same source, Foxy can migrate them as separate profile variants instead of collapsing them into one setup.
If your Arma 3 profile files are stored: If your Arma 3 profile files are stored in Documents or OneDrive, configure a dedicated profile root so Foxy can launch with -profiles=<path> and avoid sync conflicts.
Repository cards use a denser layout and: Repository cards use a denser layout and can be reordered by drag and drop, so keep the repositories you use most near the top.
You can cancel an active sync while Foxy: You can cancel an active sync while Foxy is hashing or downloading. Foxy aborts pending work, clears transient state, and returns progress to a clean idle state.
Active mod downloads bubble toward the t: Active mod downloads bubble toward the top of the update list so the most advanced work remains visible during long syncs.
Download speed and ETA estimates use rec: Download speed and ETA estimates use recent transfer history and are smoothed for slow disks or uneven networks.
Foxy cleans temporary download parts aft: Foxy cleans temporary download parts after aborted or failed transfers so stale partial files do not accumulate.
Use a custom profile root when you need: Use a custom profile root when you need Arma 3 to store profile data outside the default Documents path. Foxy passes that path to Arma 3 as -profiles=<path>.
Avoid OneDrive-synchronized profile path: Avoid OneDrive-synchronized profile paths. Foxy warns about OneDrive because cloud sync can lock or corrupt Arma 3 profile files.
Profile names and editor mission names s: Profile names and editor mission names support UTF-8 text, so non-English names should display and launch correctly.
When joining a server, Foxy can warn if: When joining a server, Foxy can warn if the server reports required addons that are available locally but disabled for the selected launch.
Offline servers do not show a Join actio: Offline servers do not show a Join action because there is no live target to connect to.
Repository space names and labels allow: Repository space names and labels allow longer values, so community names and grouping labels can be more descriptive.
Addons can be marked as favorites and fi: Addons can be marked as favorites and filtered by favorite state, which is useful in large repositories with many optional or external addons.
Optional addon choices persist across re: Optional addon choices persist across refreshes and restarts, so disabled optional addons are not silently re-enabled or re-downloaded.
Repository metadata can mark client-side: Repository metadata can mark client-side addons and server-required addons so launch prompts can explain what Foxy is about to enable.
Editor Missions are shown inside the rep: Editor Missions are shown inside the repository view so mission work stays close to the addons, profiles, and server setup it depends on.
Use the Editor Missions section to open,: Use the Editor Missions section to open, duplicate, delete, or launch Eden Editor for detected singleplayer and multiplayer mission folders.
Mission subfolders are scanned recursive: Mission subfolders are scanned recursively, so nested mission organization is supported.
Use the terrain filter beside Show folde: Use the terrain filter beside Show folders to narrow the mission list to one map when a profile contains many missions.
Use the mission context menu to remove a: Use the mission context menu to remove addon dependencies from mission.sqm when you need a cleaner mission dependency list.
If additional or external addons are ena: If additional or external addons are enabled, Foxy warns before launching Eden Editor because saving can write those addon dependencies into mission.sqm.
The editor launch warning lets you launc: The editor launch warning lets you launch with addons, launch without additional/external addons, or cancel.
When an editor launch starts, Foxy shows: When an editor launch starts, Foxy shows a toast and suppresses repeated launch clicks while Arma 3 is starting.
Settings can hide the Editor Missions li: Settings can hide the Editor Missions list globally, and repository settings can override that choice for a specific repository.
Wiping repository database entries also: Wiping repository database entries also clears legacy metadata that could otherwise leave stale MD5 protocol or update-available banners behind.
Foxy asks for confirmation before profil: Foxy asks for confirmation before profile deletion, profile reset, and full settings reset so destructive actions are harder to trigger by accident.
Use Export logs to ZIP in Settings to pa: Use Export logs to ZIP in Settings to package diagnostic logs into a timestamped Deflate-compressed archive for support.
Use the repository view visibility setti: Use the repository view visibility settings to show or hide the Editor Missions list and Servers list globally, with per-repository overrides when needed.
Use Game space settings to show or hide: Use Game space settings to show or hide the Editor Missions list and Servers list for that game space, with per-repository overrides when needed.
If the app update URL field is empty, Fo: If the app update URL field is empty, Foxy can fill it from repository-space metadata first and repository metadata second. A non-empty manual value is treated as your override.
Log files older than 90 days are cleaned: Log files older than 90 days are cleaned up automatically, and Foxy keeps up to 16 recent log files.
Foxy can use WGPU or Glow for the UI ren: Foxy can use WGPU or Glow for the UI renderer. Auto is recommended because it allows Foxy to recover when a graphics driver or WGPU path is unstable.
Choose Auto, WGPU, or Glow in Applicatio: Choose Auto, WGPU, or Glow in Application settings. Renderer changes take effect after restart.
If Foxy detects that the previous run cr: If Foxy detects that the previous run crashed inside egui-wgpu, it writes a recovery marker and switches to Glow on the next launch.
When Foxy auto-switches to Glow, it show: When Foxy auto-switches to Glow, it shows a startup notice so you know why the renderer changed. Dismissing the notice clears the notice marker.
Glow provides an OpenGL fallback for sys: Glow provides an OpenGL fallback for systems where Vulkan, DirectX, drivers, overlays, or WGPU are unstable.
Foxy profiles runtime memory pressure as: Foxy profiles runtime memory pressure as normal, constrained, or severe, then uses that tier when choosing hashing and download concurrency.
Hash scheduling applies safe caps for au: Hash scheduling applies safe caps for automatic and manual profiles when memory is constrained or severe.
Auto hash-profile benchmarking narrows c: Auto hash-profile benchmarking narrows candidate profiles under constrained resources and records cap reasons in logs.
Download scheduling adjusts large-file s: Download scheduling adjusts large-file slots, small-file slots, active range requests, per-file workers, and chunk targets from runtime limits.
The hashing and sync pipelines include o: The hashing and sync pipelines include optimized file I/O paths, including faster local content hashing for gzip-like payloads.
The UI reduces unnecessary idle redraw w: The UI reduces unnecessary idle redraw work, and repository sync states avoid extra recalculation when nothing meaningful changed.
Repeated clicks on launch, update, and o: Repeated clicks on launch, update, and other long-running actions are suppressed while the operation is starting or already in progress.
If Foxy rejects a profile path, check wh: If Foxy rejects a profile path, check whether it is inside OneDrive or contains characters that are unsafe for cross-platform file handling.
If Foxy starts with Glow after a crash,: If Foxy starts with Glow after a crash, review the Renderer and performance help tab and keep Auto selected unless you have a specific reason to force WGPU.
